name: MonarchRatingPicker
title: RatingPicker
wrapsNative: Button per value in a LazyVGrid or HStack, exposed as one element with accessibilityAdjustableAction
summary: Picks one value on a rating scale: 1 to 5 by default, or any scale with a label per value, as tiles or stars.
whenToUse: For a rating in a review or survey form.
whenNotToUse: For a number on a continuous range use the standard Slider. For one of several named options without an order use Picker.
api: init(_ label: String, value: Binding<Int?>, in range: ClosedRange<Int> = 1...5, variant: MonarchRatingPickerVariant = .scale, size: MonarchRatingPickerSize = .md, isClearable: Bool = false, isReadOnly: Bool = false, isRequired: Bool = false, error: String? = nil, valueText: ((Int?) -> String)? = nil, clearLabel: String? = nil)

init(_ label: String, value: Binding<Int?>, options: [MonarchRatingOption], variant: MonarchRatingPickerVariant = .scale, size: MonarchRatingPickerSize = .md, isClearable: Bool = false, isReadOnly: Bool = false, isRequired: Bool = false, error: String? = nil, valueText: ((Int?) -> String)? = nil, clearLabel: String? = nil)
struct MonarchRatingOption { init(_ value: Int, label: String? = nil) }

options.name: value
options.description: The chosen value, or nil for no rating yet.

options.name: range
options.description: The first and last value of a numeric scale.

options.name: options
options.description: The scale, in order, with an optional label per value.

options.name: variant
options.description: scale draws tiles with the number and label; stars draws stars with the chosen label beside them.

options.name: size
options.description: sm has tighter tiles and 20-point stars; md has 24-point stars.

options.name: isClearable
options.description: Choosing the chosen value again clears the rating, and VoiceOver gets a "Clear rating" action.

options.name: isReadOnly
options.description: Shows the rating without dimming it and ignores touches.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds "Required" to the hint.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown under the scale with an icon, read in the hint and announced.

options.name: clearLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Clear rating" action name.

states.name: no rating
states.description: No tile is chosen and every star is an outline.

states.name: rated
states.description: The chosen tile has the accent-subtle fill and a 2-point accent border; stars up to the value are filled in the strong warning colour.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A tile takes the emphasis background.

states.name: read-only
states.description: Looks like the rated state and does not respond.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle tiles and the disabled text colour, set with disabled(_:).

appearance: Tiles are surface-coloured with a default border and 8-point corners. Stars are outlines in the strong border colour and filled in the strong warning colour.
platformNotes: The web is a radio group with arrow keys; on iOS the picker is one adjustable element, which is how VoiceOver users change a rating. The web's invalid and required states, and form name, are not offered.
accessibility: The picker is one adjustable element: its label is label and its value reads "3 of 5", with the option's label when it has one, or "No rating".
Swiping up or down moves the rating one step along the scale and stops at the ends.
A clearable rating that has a value has a "Clear rating" custom action.
A read-only or disabled picker is read with its value and is not adjustable.
The chosen tile has a heavier border and filled stars differ from empty ones by shape, not colour alone.
Every tile and star has a 44-point touch target; tiles wrap onto more rows.
edgeCases: A value that is not on the scale reads "No rating" and nothing is drawn as chosen.
Adjusting follows the order of the options, not their numbers.
Stars that do not fit in one row wrap, and the caption moves under them.
An empty scale draws only the label and is not adjustable.

examples.title: Labelled scale
examples.template:
MonarchRatingPicker(
    {{label}},
    value: $rating,
    options: [
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.0.value}}, label: {{options.0.label}}),
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.1.value}}, label: {{options.1.label}}),
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.2.value}}, label: {{options.2.label}}),
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.3.value}}, label: {{options.3.label}}),
        MonarchRatingOption({{options.4.value}}, label: {{options.4.label}}),
    ]
)
.labelsHidden()
examples.code:
MonarchRatingPicker(
    "Overall rating",
    value: $rating,
    options: [
        MonarchRatingOption(1, label: "Below"),
        MonarchRatingOption(2, label: "Partly meets"),
        MonarchRatingOption(3, label: "Meets"),
        MonarchRatingOption(4, label: "Exceeds"),
        MonarchRatingOption(5, label: "Outstanding"),
    ]
)
.labelsHidden()

examples.title: Stars that can be cleared
examples.code: MonarchRatingPicker("Your rating", value: $rating, variant: .stars, isClearable: true)

examples.title: A label per value
examples.code:
MonarchRatingPicker(
    "Performance",
    value: $score,
    options: [
        MonarchRatingOption(1, label: "Below"),
        MonarchRatingOption(2, label: "Meets"),
        MonarchRatingOption(3, label: "Exceeds"),
    ]
)

examples.title: Required with an error
examples.code:
MonarchRatingPicker(
    "Overall",
    value: $rating,
    variant: .stars,
    isRequired: true,
    error: rating == nil ? "Choose a rating." : nil
)
